messages.content: Can you tell me a machine to bake a chocolate cake?

function.name: prepare_food_get_recipe
function.description: Retrieve a recipe based on specific ingredients and type of food. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients for the recipe.

food_type.description: The type of food for the recipe.

serving_size.description: The number of servings the recipe should cater to. Default is 1.

message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick rundown of the most common appliances you can use to bake a chocolate cake:

| Appliance | Typical Use | Why it’s good for cakes |
|-----------|-------------|------------------------|
| **Conventional oven** | Classic baking | Precise temperature control; great for even baking. |
| **Convection oven** | Faster, even baking | Fan circulates hot air, reducing baking time and improving rise. |
| **Toaster oven** | Small batches | Compact, energy‑efficient, and often has a “cake” preset. |
| **Microwave** | Quick “microwave cake” | Uses a “cake” setting; perfect for single servings. |
| **Air fryer** | Crispy edges | Some models have a “cake” mode; uses less oil. |
| **Slow cooker** | Moist, tender cakes | Ideal for “slow‑cooked” cakes; keeps them moist. |
| **Instant Pot** | Multi‑function | Has a “cake” setting; can steam or pressure‑cook. |
| **Sous vide** | Precision cooking | Can bake a cake at a very precise temperature for a silky crumb. |
| **Smart oven (e.g., June Oven, Tovala)** | Automated baking | Uses sensors and pre‑set recipes; hands‑free. |
| **Robot chef (e.g., Moley, RoboChef)** | Fully automated | Handles mixing, baking, and plating. |
| **Cake maker (e.g., Cuisinart, Zojirushi, Panasonic)** | Dedicated cake appliance | Often has a “cake” preset and built‑in timer. |
| **Thermomix / KitchenAid** | All‑in‑one | Mixes, kneads, and can bake with a built‑in oven. |

If you’re looking for a specific brand or model, let me know your budget or kitchen space constraints, and I can narrow down the best options for you!
